archetype: 5 (Luxury Light variant) mixed with 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast for SaaS)

top_nav.style: Glassmorphism with backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80, sticky top-0 z-50, 1px border-b border-border/40
top_nav.active_tab: Subtle pill background (bg-slate-100) or bold text with a 2px bottom border in gold

cards.style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-border/50 shadow-sm transition-all duration-200 hover:shadow-md hover:border-border

buttons.primary: bg-navy text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-navy/90 transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-white text-navy border border-border/60 rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors
buttons.sparkle: bg-gold text-white rounded-full px-6 py-2.5 font-medium hover:bg-gold/90 transition-all shadow-md hover:shadow-lg flex items-center gap-2

empty_states.style: flex flex-col items-center justify-center p-12 text-center border-2 border-dashed border-border/60 rounded-3xl bg-slate-50/50

layout.spacing_scale: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside cards. gap-6 or gap-8 between sections.
layout.home_tab: Bento grid layout. Today's Featured spans large columns. Stats use tight bento cards.
layout.workspace_tab: CSS Grid for cards with gap-6. Clear hierarchy in the detail view.
layout.promote_tab: Clean, centered stepper wizard. Large drag-drop area with dashed borders.
layout.mobile: Ensure no overflow, p-4 padding on mobile, stack grids to 1 column.

visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Smooth 0.2s ease transitions on transforms and opacity. Staggered fade-ins.

icons.sizing: w-5 h-5 for inline, w-8 h-8 for empty states/heroes

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets 4.5:1 against background. Use text-navy instead of light gray for important text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

image_urls.description: Premium dish on white ceramic plate - useful for 'Today's Featured' or 'Workspace Project hero'
Cooked food on white plate - for library asset previews
Modern restaurant interior for onboarding card or dashboard background

instructions_to_main_agent: Refactor index.css to replace vintage typography/shadows with the new premium SaaS tokens.
Update tailwind.config.js to include Outfit and Plus Jakarta Sans.
Revamp top navigation to use Glassmorphism and clear active states.
Redesign HomeTab using a bento grid. Today's featured must feel like a premium hero.
Redesign WorkspaceTab to use rounded-2xl cards with soft shadows and cleaner stat pills.
Redesign Promote wizard to feel like a high-end AI tool.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
Make sure mobile layout is perfect (no overflow, stack grids).
Maintain all backend API logic as is. Do not touch backend routes.
